checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~8s vertical video of a fictional adult woman addressing camera at home
must.why: Both clips are 8 s, vertical, with a woman in her 30s in a living room looking at the camera.

must.item: Complete script audible in English without omissions or additions
must.why: Audio was not transcribed. Her mouth moves throughout, and the caption timing fits the script.

must.item: Readable captions reproduce script exactly and follow speech
must.why: Large yellow-highlighted captions show 'FitTrack makes planning my workouts so' and 'I finally have a routine that sticks.' They match the script. 'easy.' was not in a sampled frame and the last frame has no caption, but the wording appears intact.

must.item: Presenter visibly speaks rather than a still image
must.why: Mouth shapes, head position and gestures change across frames.

must.item: Ad does not label presenter as verified or real customer
must.why: No such label appears on screen. The reply says she is AI-made.

exact_text.text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
exact_text.read_as: Captions read 'FitTrack makes planning my workouts so' (the word 'easy.' is not in a sampled frame) and 'I finally have a routine that sticks.' The wording is intact across the two sampled caption frames.

faults.what: Hands are blurry and smeared with reddish tint at 0.8 s, so they look like AI artefacts.
No phone is visible although it is framed as selfie-style, and her arms hang at her sides. The framing looks like a camera on a stand.
Captions sit over her chest and are large and heavy. They are readable but not very polished.
Two clips were produced, one with captions and one without. The captioned one is the intended final, and the extra clip is harmless.
The delivery looks a bit intense, with wide eyes and an animated expression. It is slightly less casual than asked.

summary: A clean 8-second vertical testimonial of a plausible fictional woman speaking to camera at home, with matching highlighted captions; the audio is unverified, and there are minor hand artefacts and a missing visible phone.
